ProgramUnit.Name: DISPLAY_BANNER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure display_banner is
 description VARCHAR2(48);
begin
-- Show system Menu by default
--
 default_value('N/A','global.news_id');
--
 if :global.news_id = 'N/A'
 then
 description := 'NEWS MODULE';
 else
 begin
 select description
 into description
 from news_status
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id and
 news_id = :global.news_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Msg: No news status for '||:global.news_id );
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 end if;
--
 :global.module_name := description ;
 --:global.program_version:='3.01.01';
 execute_trigger('UTIL_BANNER');
 check_package_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: DISPLAY_NEWS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure display_news is
begin
 display_banner;
 if form_failure
 then
 message ('err display banner');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 20;
 :global.last_block := :system.cursor_block;
 go_block('news');
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level := 0;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_REF_NO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure get_ref_no is
begin
 select news_id into :print.news_id
 from news_status
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id and
 news_id = :news.news_id;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Msg: News ID does not exist for '||:news.news_id );
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then
 message ('Err get news id' );
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPDATE_NEWS_LOG
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure update_news_log is
begin
 select 'x' into :global.x
 from news_log
 where appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id and
 news_id = :global.news_id and
 user_id = :banner.user_id;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 insert into news_log
 ( appl_id , news_id ,
 user_id , access_date )
 values
 ( :ctrl_block_1.appl_id , :global.news_id ,
 :banner.user_id , sysdate );
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 when others then handle_error;
end;

elsif

-- go_block ('NEWS');

else

Trigger.Name: KEY-PRINT
Trigger.TriggerText:
:global.last_block := :system.cursor_block;
if :system.cursor_block = 'news'
then
 get_ref_no;
 if form_failure then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
else
 :print.news_id := :news_status.news_id;
end if;
go_block('PRINT');

InitForm;
begin
--
-- If system name not known, can not show news
--
 default_value('DON','global.appl_id');
 if :global.appl_id = 'N/A' then
 message('Err: Application not known, must set APPL ID.');
 pause;
 exit_form(no_validate);
 end if;
 :ctrl_block_1.appl_id := :global.appl_id ;
 display_banner;
--
 :system.message_level := '15';
 go_block('news_status');
 execute_query;
 if :system.block_status = 'NEW'
 then
 message ('Msg: No news available at present.' );
 exit_form (no_validate);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := '0';
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026)
 then
 show_error('1706');
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error('1707');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error('5016');
 elsif error_code in ('0') -- invalid format
 then
 show_error('0022',GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK)); 
 elsif error_code in ('41011') -- invad attribute
 then null; 
 else 
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
